sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Disconnect power supply of the system.

Disconnect all connections 
 for each fire detectors frequently.
Connect power supply of the system.
Check all fire detectors.

Each fire detectors should be tested for proper operation by heating it in 
 oil bath.
Check the temperature, which close the contact of fire detector

The temperature setting of the detectors is stamped on its identification 
 plate.
Repeat all steps ( 4- 5 6 ) all fire detectors.
If any detector is out of calibration limit it should be replaced.

sections.text: NOTE

Do not use a propane torch to heat the detectors because the light flam 
 temperature of the torch may destroy calibration of the detectors.

It is not possible to accurately check the calibration of the detectors by 
 heating it in an oil bath or with a heat lamp because the set point of the 
 detectors is sensitive to the rate of heading which cannot be easily 
 determined without specialized equipment.
Return System into Service

items: Connect all detectors in the same place.
Connect the power supply to the system.
Check all alarms.
Put the system at automatic mode.
